notes: Performance-only expression/gaze/head-pose combos. Deliberately does NOT touch face shape, eye color, ethnicity, age, hair identity, or freckle density -- identity comes from IDENTITY_ANCHOR/LENA_MASTER_IDENTITY/SKIN_REALISM elsewhere in the prompt. Each entry composes into exactly one short prompt line via format_expression_gaze_line().
